overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly specialized academic and professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a total reach of 3,580 followers. Engagement across all platforms is notably high for academic profiles, driven primarily by announcements of publications, software releases, research grants, and career/study opportunities in computational social science and disinformation detection.

contentThemes.description: Focus on research, tools (like CooRnet v2.0), papers, and conference presentations about coordinated link sharing and information operations.
Announcements regarding research grants, paper publications, and software releases.
Posts offering postdoctoral positions and PhD opportunities in computational social science.

recommendations: Cross-post high-performing research announcements (like paper publications) consistently across all three platforms to maximize reach.
Include direct links, visuals, or infographics when announcing tool releases and paper publications to boost engagement even further.
Engage with replies and comments directly on Bluesky and LinkedIn to drive algorithmic visibility on opportunistic posts.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest relative engagement rate (avg 6.14%), particularly for paper publications and student recruitment posts, indicating an active academic community.
platformInsights.mastodon: Generates steady engagement among open-web academics, performing best with technical project updates like software tool releases (CooRnet v2.0).
platformInsights.linkedin: Commands the largest total audience (1,850 followers) and highest absolute volume of likes and comments, excelling at major professional announcements like research grants and hiring.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
Excited to announce that our research team has been awarded a new grant to study information operations across social media platforms.
